summary: Completed testing of Media Library 3-dot dropdown menu feature. All requested features are working correctly. Backend APIs pass all tests (8/8). Frontend UI shows dropdown menu with 4 options (Preview, Rename, Get URL, Delete) on hover over image cards.
passed_tests: Media Library page loads with folder sidebar
Site Images folder shows uploaded images in grid view
Images render properly (not broken) in the grid boxes - showing green placeholder images
3-dot dropdown menu appears on hover over image cards (top-right corner)
Dropdown menu has 4 options: Preview, Rename, Get URL, Delete
Preview option opens image preview modal with filename, size, Download and Delete buttons
Rename option opens rename dialog with input field pre-filled with current filename
Get URL option copies image URL to clipboard and shows toast 'URL copied to clipboard!'
Delete option is available in dropdown (red/destructive color)
Property folder files also have the 4-option dropdown menu (verified in code)
Backend API: GET /api/site-images returns list of images with filename, url, size
Backend API: PUT /api/site-images/{filename}/rename successfully renames files
Backend API: Rename endpoint returns 404 for nonexistent files
Backend API: Rename endpoint blocks path traversal attacks (returns 400)
Backend API: DELETE /api/site-images/{filename} returns 404 for nonexistent files
Backend API: Site images endpoints require authentication
Backend API: GET /api/media/folders returns property folders list
Backend API: GET /api/media/folders/{id} returns folder contents with files and subfolders
